approved_translation: Patience and loyalty are rewarded; a noble spirit endures hardship without complaint.
translation_author: Ellen C. Babbitt (retold from traditional sources)
context_summary: Once upon a time a number of carpenters lived on a river bank near a large forest. Every day the carpenters went in boats to the forest to cut down the trees and make them into lumber. Then with a last look at his playmates, the children, the beautiful white Elephant went on with the king. The king was proud of his new Elephant and took the best care of him as long as he lived.
